_regression.source: real map: Mizuguchi (scripted hamlet) as generated 2026-08-16 BEFORE the woodland canopy was recorded - the known-open ledger's crowns-are-ink-only gap, flagged independently by both review rounds: the coppice parcels' crowns were SVG circles only (tree_crowns held just the windbreak and copse), so no manifest check could count a stand's canopy - which is exactly how Inashiro's 100%-marsh zero-crown parcel had shipped green. commons(role=woodland) now records each drawn crown into tree_crowns plus a per-parcel count, and this check holds the declaration-exists invariant.
